edits.newText:
return HeroFeedbackSurface(
        flashController: heroFlashController,
        onPlayPause: () => player.playPause(),
        onPrevious: () => player.previous(),
        onNext: () => player.next(),
        onSeek: (d) => player.seek(d),
        positionMs: () => player.songInfo?.position ?? 0,
        durationMs: () => player.songInfo?.duration ?? 0,
        // Linux: replace the centered seek HUD with a bottom crumb line
        // preview. Other platforms keep the existing HUD.
        showCenterSeekHud: !linuxSeekFeedback,
        onSeekPreview: linuxSeekFeedback
            ? (targetMs, durationMs, fraction) =>
                seekPreview.value = _SeekPreview(
                  targetMs: targetMs,
                  durationMs: durationMs,
                  fraction: fraction,
                )
            : null,
        onSeekPreviewEnd: linuxSeekFeedback
            ? () => seekPreview.value = null
            : null,
        onVerticalDragUpdate: acceptVertical ? onHeroVerticalDrag : null,
        onVerticalDragEnd: acceptVertical ? onHeroVerticalDragEnd : null,
        child: child,
      );
